lines.text: It starts with a conversation. I talk the problem through with AI, out loud, until every corner of it is clear.
That conversation becomes tickets. And every ticket is assigned to Nafanya. Yes, I give my agents names.
Nafanya is my orchestrator. It reads the tickets, makes a plan, and hands the work to three developer agents.
Kuzya, Bublik and Pelmen get to work. In parallel.
When a developer is stuck, it asks the orchestrator. Most answers come straight back. But if the decision is mine, Nafanya texts me. I answer, and the work goes on.
Every agent can look things up in the project docs. So they don't guess.
When the code is ready, a different model reviews it. A second pair of eyes that thinks differently.
Then CI. If a test fails, the developer fixes it and tries again. Until everything is green.
The pull request is merged and goes to staging.
In the morning I wake up, make coffee, and test what was built overnight.
And what the agents learned goes back into the docs. So tomorrow, they start smarter.
